questions.question: Whirling hygrometer should be whirled at an approximate speed of_____

answers.a: Dry bulb temperature = Wet bulb temperature
answers.b: Wet bulb temperature > Dry bulb temperature

questions.question: Wet bulb temperature is measure of _____

answers.a: Temperature of moisture present in air

questions.question: Dry bulb temperature is measure of

answers.a: Lower is the value of wet bulb temperature
answers.b: Higher is the value of wet bulb temperature
answers.c: Wet bulb temperature is greater than dry bulb temperature

questions.question: Which of the following statement is incorrect?

answers.a: Wet bulb temperature can be equal to dry bulb temperature
answers.b: Wet bulb temperature can never be higher than dry bulb temperature
answers.c: Flow of heat at muslin cloth take place through radiation and convection both
answers.d: Flow of heat at muslin cloth take place through convection only

questions.question: Which of the following statement is correct?

answers.a: Flow of heat from air to bulb with wet muslin cloth is slower than the rate of heat loss from the bulb with wet muslin due to evaporation
answers.b: At wet bulb temperature, flow of heat from air to bulb with wet muslin cloth is equal to the rate of heat loss from the bulb with wet muslin due to evaporation
answers.c: Flow of heat from air to bulb with wet muslin cloth is higher than the rate of heat loss from the bulb with wet muslin due to evaporation
